deposits.title: Guyana 2040: From Resource Wealth to Strategic Statecraft
deposits.creator: Ramsaroop, Ragunauth
deposits.description: An independent framework for translating Guyana's resource wealth into enduring institutional, productive and national capabilities.

deposits.title: Guyana Power Demand 2030
deposits.creator: Ramsaroop, Ragunauth
deposits.description: An evidence-led assessment that separates measured demand from development scenarios and evaluates generation and grid requirements through 2030.

deposits.title: Critical Minerals Are the New Energy Security
deposits.creator: Ramsaroop, Ragunauth
deposits.description: A research monograph examining mining, processing concentration, trade, investment, circular supply and governance across strategic mineral value chains.

deposits.title: Guyana Economy 2030
deposits.creator: Ramsaroop, Ragunauth
deposits.description: An independent analysis of the choices, assumptions and risks involved in converting exceptional resource revenue into durable national prosperity.

deposits.title: The New Geography of Globalization
deposits.creator: Ramsaroop, Ragunauth
deposits.description: A comparative study of trade, industrial policy, investment, technology and supply-chain restructuring in a period of geopolitical fragmentation.

deposits.title: Water Security as Economic Security
deposits.creator: Ramsaroop, Ragunauth
deposits.description: A systems analysis of water risk across agriculture, energy, industry, AI infrastructure, finance, trade and national resilience to 2040.

deposits.title: Guyana's Low Carbon Development Strategy 2030
deposits.creator: Ramsaroop, Ragunauth
deposits.description: An independent evidence review of forest conservation, carbon finance, national development and governance accountability under Guyana's Low Carbon Development Strategy 2030.
